description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the count of four different types of code-related resources: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and GitHub files. The x-axis represents the “Number of Tokens” on a linear scale, ranging from 200 to 800, with tick marks labeled at intervals of 200. The y-axis represents the count of resources, also on a linear scale, ranging from 10 to 40, with tick marks labeled at intervals of 10. The blue line with circular markers, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 23 and increases to about 27. The red line with circular markers, representing Library Documentation, begins at about 25, rises to a peak of approximately 28 at 600 tokens, and then slightly declines to around 26. The green line with circular markers, representing GitHub files, starts at about 26, rises to a peak of approximately 30 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to around 28. The yellow line with circular markers, representing StackOverflow posts, begins at approximately 33, decreases steadily to about 12 at 800 tokens.
